address: 40 Soi Ayothaya 4/3, Phai Ling, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, 13000, Thailand
bio: This shop beside a canal exudes charm, with its simple wooden shelves and tables. Highlights include the boat noodles in a well-balanced broth and the richly flavoured dry beef soup with tender slices and slow-cooked meat, lifted by roasted peanut aroma....
